global_open_questions: 1. THE HERO CONTEST. Two textures (T_Hero_Bearer, T_Hero_Vanguard) both claim to be 'the hero the Unit Cam draws', and a third legacy asset (T_Unit_Retinue) is contested against the six-variant roster on the retinue side. This matrix deliberately does not resolve either contest -- see each entry's open_questions. The owner decision that would resolve it is flame-bearer.md canon proposal 2 (ratify or reject the single-bearer supersession of vanguard.md).

2. DIRECTION-ONLY VS. WALK-FRAME RETINUE SHEETS. Every soldier-roster-v1.md variant (T_Soldier_01..06) and the archer proxy are built as 8 static directional poses with NO walk-frame variation (frame_axes: ["direction"]), while the code's own SwarmSheet contract (SwarmFragments.h) and the Bearer/Vanguard hero sheets both use direction x walk_frame. If these six-plus-one textures are meant to be drawn per-soldier the way T_Swarm_2bit is today (one shared atlas, one SubUV index per unit), the current per-variant sheets cannot supply a walk animation without either a redesign of how the Unit Cam slices cells, or a second generation pass adding a walk1 pose to each variant. This is a real, load-bearing design question this matrix surfaces rather than answers.

3. NO GLOBAL PROVENANCE RECORD EXISTS YET. docs/data/art/provenance.json is named as the manifest location in docs/backlog/task-050 but does not exist anywhere in the repo as of 2026-07-27 -- the pipeline's actual per-generation record today is RawArt/Renders/<id>/r<rev>/manifest.json (Scripts/art/pixelpipe.py's own convention). Every entry in this matrix will therefore audit as 'unrecorded' until either provenance.json is created, or the 'unrecorded' check is pointed at the per-request manifests instead -- a decision for whoever owns that file next (task-050), not this matrix.
